notes: «أبي رحمه الله» is the compiler's own father, named only by relation.
The text reads «في بن إبراهيم» where a name is expected; the surface is kept as written and the reading is left to the archive.
The Imam is named after «عن», so he is a narrator; the saying «إن ملكا عظيم الشأن» follows with no further link.

fixes.reason: The name before «بن إبراهيم بن هاشم» is written as the particle «في», which is not a name; the text may be garbled.

evidence.quote: حدثنا في بن إبراهيم بن هاشم
